verifications.claim: Samsung will discontinue Samsung Messages in July 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Samsung Messages will be discontinued in July 2026" (R1); "discontinue its Messages app in July 2026" (R2); "discontinued in July 2026" (R3, R4); "discontinued in July 2026" (R5); "discontinued by July" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state discontinuation in July 2026.

verifications.claim: Samsung will replace Samsung Messages with Google Messages as the default texting application on Galaxy devices.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The default messaging app will be Google Messages" (R1); "Google Messages will replace Samsung Messages" (R2); "switching to Google Messages" as default (R3, R4, R6); "set it as their default messaging app" (R4); "set Google Messages as your default messaging app" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state Google Messages becomes the default replacement.

verifications.claim: Samsung Messages will no longer be pre-installed on new devices.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Samsung stopped pre-installing its Messages app on flagship Galaxy devices" (R2, back in 2024)
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly confirms stopped pre-installing on new flagships; others imply via default Google Messages.

verifications.claim: Samsung Messages will no longer be supported on new devices.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Samsung Messages app will no longer be supported" on Android 12+ (newer devices) (R1); "Newer devices, including the Galaxy S26 series, already do not support installing" (R2); continues on Android 11 or lower only (R3)
verifications.reasoning: New devices (Android 12+) lose support post-2026; already unsupported on latest like S26.

verifications.claim: Users can still use Samsung Messages on some older devices.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Not affected (for now) are devices running Android 11 or older" (R1); "Devices running Android 11 or lower remain unaffected" (R2); "continue to function on devices running Android 11 or lower" (R3); "Users of older Android operating systems (dating back to Android 11 or older) will not be impacted" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state older Android 11 or lower devices unaffected.
